note: Gratuity under the Code on Social Security, 2020 (Section 53), in force from 21-11-2025 (Ministry of Labour FAQs, 16-03-2026: gratuity on the revised definition of wages applies w.e.f. 21.11.2025). Every figure the Gratuity screen and the Full & Final use is HERE. Change the law here, not in PHP.
law: Code on Social Security, 2020, s.53 (gratuity) with s.2(88) wages = Code on Wages, 2019, s.2(y)
eligibility_note: Five years of CONTINUOUS service, counted in full years from the date of joining (no rounding for eligibility).

fixed_term.note: Fixed-term employees: gratuity after one year of service under the contract, proportionately (s.53(1) proviso).

no_minimum_service_note: Death, or disablement due to accident or disease: no minimum service (s.53(1) proviso).
count_240_days_note: Off = the Code's text (five completed years). On = treat 4 years + 240 days in the fifth year as five years (s.2A continuous service as read by several High Courts). A legal decision for the employer, not a default.
part_year_note: For the amount: every completed year, and any part of a year IN EXCESS OF six months, counts as a year. Exactly six months does not.
days_factor_note: 15 days' wages per counted year; a monthly-rated wage is divided by 26.
statutory_cap_note: Maximum notified by the Central Government (Rs 20 lakh). Change here when a new notification raises it.
wage_components_note: Wages = basic pay + dearness allowance + retaining allowance (Code on Wages s.2(y)).

fifty_percent_rule.note: If the excluded items (HRA, conveyance, special allowance, overtime, commission, etc.) exceed 50% of total remuneration, the excess is added back to wages (s.2(y) first proviso).

not_remuneration_note: Lines that are not remuneration for the 50% test: reimbursements, refunds, encashment, and annual performance-based incentives/bonus (Labour Codes FAQ 4).
rate_note: Wages LAST DRAWN means the monthly RATE: a month with loss-of-pay days is scaled back up to the full month (period days / payable days).
basic_flag_note: Used only when the employee has no payroll run yet: the components carrying this flag stand in for wages.
